title: Topic Modeling & LDA
interviewAnswer: Latent Dirichlet Allocation is a probabilistic topic model where documents are mixtures of latent topics and topics are distributions over words.
why: Topic models remain useful for interpretable exploratory structure in corpora.
intuition: A document may combine several themes rather than belong to one hard cluster.
deepDive: LDA uses Dirichlet priors over document-topic and topic-word distributions; inference estimates hidden topic assignments.
commonMistakes: Confusing topic-model LDA with Linear Discriminant Analysis.
Treating topics as objective ground truth.
production: Check topic stability and human usefulness; embeddings can capture richer semantics but have different interpretability.
workedExample: Customer feedback can be summarized into recurring themes before labels exist.
